examples.text: Une ambiance sexy avec des maillots de bain.
Une ambiance sexy, des maillots de bain... La petite Mathurine est superbe!
examples.trans: A sexy atmosphere, swimsuits... Little Mathurine is gorgeous!

meanings.note: Si tu veux = if you want. French conjunction meaning 'if', used to link clauses in spoken and written discourse.
answering a negative question: Aucune nouvelle? - Si!

examples.text: Si tu veux, on peut en parler demain matin.
examples.trans: If you want, we can talk about it tomorrow morning.

examples.text: Dis-moi tout de suite si le rôle t'intéresse.
examples.trans: Tell me right away if the role interests you.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Oui, trois cent mille. Je parle de ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

examples.text: Une ambiance sexy, des maillots de bain... La petite Mathurine est superbe!

meanings.note: Sur la table, sur la route. Core French preposition meaning 'on', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.

examples.text: Attention, tu arrives sur la route!

meanings.note: Passé composé with 'être'. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to fall'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'tombé').

meanings.note: Tout le monde = everybody. Spoken French det expression meaning 'all', common in natural conversation.

examples.text: C'est tout ce que je peux faire.
Désolé, c'est tout ce que je peux faire.

Number; l'un = one of them. Spoken French det expression meaning 'a', common in natural conversation.

examples.text: L'un à midi, l'autre à deux heures.
examples.trans: One at noon, the other at two.

meanings.note: Invariable French adverb meaning 'quickly'; placed immediately after the conjugated verb in simple tenses.

examples.trans: But I quickly pulled it back.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Tu crois vraiment qu'il va accepter ce rôle?
examples.trans: Do you really think he is going to accept this role?

examples.text: Je suis vraiment désolée pour ce petit retard.
examples.trans: I am truly sorry for this slight delay.
